observationScope.title: Observation scope
observationScope.inheritHelp: Follow the observation scope configured in global settings.

descriptions.combined: Consolidate once using all tags together. Observations belong to the full tag set, keeping knowledge specific to that combination.
descriptions.shared: Consolidate into one global, untagged scope across memories with different tags. Useful when session tags should not separate shared knowledge.
descriptions.per_tag: Consolidate separately for each tag. Each tag builds independent observations across memories, without creating scopes for tag combinations.
descriptions.all_combinations: Consolidate for every non-empty subset of tags, including individual tags and combinations. Three tags create seven scopes and seven consolidation passes.
descriptions.custom: Choose the exact tag groups to consolidate. Each group creates one independent scope, avoiding combinations you do not need.

observationScope.customHelp: Add at least one tag to each scope. Use dynamic tags to follow the current task, source or source group; choose Shared for a global, untagged scope.
observationScope.emptyGroup: Add at least one tag to each scope.
observationScope.exponentialWarning: Scopes can grow exponentially: n tags produce 2ⁿ − 1 scopes per document, increasing processing time and cost.
observationScope.fileLimitation: Observation scopes apply to text and inline content. File uploads use Combined.
observationScope.tagsUnavailable: Could not load bank tags. You can still enter a tag.
